territoriality.finding: Brazilian independent project and ANCINE approval rules; Rio spend belongs to RioFilme.

minimum_spend.finding: RioFilme minimums cannot be assigned to ANCINE.

cap.finding: The operative limitation is tied to specified tax and investment rules, not RioFilme's municipal cap.

currentness.finding: Current ANCINE pages continue to describe the tax-incentive framework; RioFilme is a distinct municipal call.

corrections: Do not classify ANCINE as non-economic; classify the named mechanism as financing support and keep RioFilme separate.

territoriality.finding: India-incurred qualifying expenditure under the relevant foreign-film/co-production service track.

uplift.finding: Two conditional 5-point components within a 40% maximum; official co-productions and pure post/VFX have different applicability.

monetization.finding: Cash incentive, interim/final disbursement on committee recommendation.

currentness.finding: Later official MIB/PIB materials resolve the apparently inconsistent 40% headline as the maximum, not the base formula.

corrections: Replace 40%+5%+5%=50% with 30% base plus applicable 5-point conditions, capped at 40%; model track-specific thresholds and uplifts.

rate_formula.finding: The current ACAU cash-rebate calls and the new July 2026 tax credit are separate instruments. The tax credit is 30% of admitted Uruguay expenditure; the handoff's three-tier cash-rebate table was not primary-confirmed and cannot be canonicalized.

qpe_basis.finding: Tax credit: admitted expenditure actually incurred and audited in Uruguay. Cash rebate: the selected call's eligible Uruguay spend.

territoriality.finding: Actual expenditure in Uruguay; local payer alone is insufficient.

payroll_residency.finding: Applicant/taxpayer and local-production-company requirements differ by instrument.

minimum_spend.finding: Tax credit minimum is UI1,200,000 admitted spend. Cash-rebate minimum must come from the applicable current call, not an unverified generic tier table.

cap.finding: No generic USD700k/850k/1m tier table is primary-confirmed for current doctrine; tax-credit annual maximum may be set by MEF.

uplift.finding: Cash-rebate call additions and tax-credit committee percentage are instrument-specific.

monetization.finding: Cash rebate for selected PUA calls; tax certificates valid 36 months and assignable only as DGI authorizes to specified institutions.

currentness.finding: Decree 153/026 was published 17 July 2026 and expressly prevents the same project receiving both PUA cash rebate and the new tax credit.

corrections: Rename/restructure away from Uruguay XXI; separate ACAU cash-rebate calls from the July 2026 tax credit; discard the unsupported generic three-tier table.

targeted_research_performed.scope: current ACAU calls, Decree 153/026, rate, minimum, selection and mutual exclusivity

source_assessment.assessment: Current statute/decree and ACAU materials materially supersede the handoff's secondary tier claim.
